about: Second held-out evaluation set: 40 fictional people (E41-E80; 10 students, 10 in work, 10 switchers, 10 job seekers), written on 2026-11-17 for stage 7 before any stage 7 change was run on them. Synthetic data, not validated with real people. Same rules as eval/personas.json (eval/LABELING.md).
